capabilities: Display Markdown tasks on a monthly calendar with completion status
Sync task creation, edits, deletion, and completion both ways between calendar and file
Bind the calendar to todo-calendar.md or any chosen Markdown file
Filter tasks by overdue, next 3 days, next 7 days, or no deadline
Open the calendar in the main workspace or the right sidebar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Task dates use a custom "@ YYYY-MM-DD" tag appended to standard Markdown task lines.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view for tasks stored as Markdown checklist items with deadlines, so dates must be tracked by reading the file.
summary: Task calendar that renders Markdown to-do lists from a bound file as a monthly calendar and timeline with bi-directional sync.
